svg.title: lifeboat: Bitnami's Postgres images, rebuilt from source.
svg.desc: A newspaper clipping. CONTAINERS. Bitnami's Postgres images, rebuilt from source. PostgreSQL and PostgreSQL HA (repmgr) images with the same paths, scripts and env vars: a drop-in for the Bitnami Helm charts. Every upstream source SHA-256 pinned, amd64 and arm64. ghcr.io/intikhab49/lifeboat.
